answer: An epoch-chained continuity bond: each epoch an agent signs a commitment to a state advanced from its previous one and locks a bond released only after many verified epochs of work. Standing tracks chain length, not headcount. A farm minting ten thousand keys holds ten thousand zero-length chains, earning nothing until each fake identity pays: sustained compute, storage of every chain on ferrous media, capital locked for months. Wander across identities and one break zeroes standing and forfeits the bond. Weight is a buoy on a wide ocean, holding only while it returns to its anchored line.
